title: Brendan Eich: JavaScript, Firefox, Mozilla, and Brave | Lex Fridman Podcast #160
summary: A roughly three-hour Lex Fridman podcast conversation with Brendan Eich, creator of JavaScript and co-founder of Mozilla and Brave. It covers JavaScript's rushed creation at Netscape, the browser wars, Firefox and Mozilla, and Brave's privacy approach.
why: Linked as a source for first-hand JavaScript and Netscape history, with commenters pointing to specific segments like the Java versus JavaScript decision.

quote.text: a real gem of an interview, in my opinion
